rationale: The importer differential lab now classifies a native-theme range, checkbox, radio, button or button input as ua-theme-skinned instead of the ua-default-form-chrome support boundary, because the native lowering paints those with Chromium's own theme. Paths: tools/import-validation/importer_differential/form_controls.py (visual-proof-harness, design-output-and-packaging), docs/tools/importer-differential-lab.md (design-output-and-packaging) and test/test_importer_differential_lab.py and .agents/skills/import-design/SKILL.md (design-source-ingest). It changes only the lab's advisory classification: no score, threshold, capture, renderer or promotion default moves, and every themed control without a native skin stays a boundary.
